name: converzap
description: Work with your ConverZAP account (WhatsApp Business Platform inbox, contacts, CRM pipeline, campaigns and automations) from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
ConverZAP connects your business WhatsApp (official WhatsApp Business Platform) to an AI agent, a shared inbox, a CRM pipeline, campaigns and automations. This plugin lets you work with your own ConverZAP account from ChatGPT.

Ask questions about your data: which customers are waiting for a reply, what a contact asked, how your deals are moving, which message templates are approved and how your inbox performed this week.

If you grant write permissions, ChatGPT can also act for you: reply to a conversation, schedule a message, assign, label, snooze or resolve conversations, add internal notes, create or update contacts and deals, move deals between stages, draft a campaign and start it, and enroll a contact in an automation.

Safety by design:
- You choose the account and the permissions on the ConverZAP consent screen; ChatGPT never gets more access than you have in the app.
- Read and write permissions are separate, and write permissions are unchecked by default.
- Messages follow WhatsApp rules: free text only inside the 24-hour window, approved templates outside it, and contacts who opted out are never messaged.
- Every write tool supports a dry run that shows what would happen without changing anything, and repeated calls are not executed twice.
- Text written by your customers is marked as untrusted so it is never treated as an instruction.

Requires a ConverZAP account on a plan with API access. Disconnect at any time in ConverZAP under Settings > Public API.
capabilities: Find contacts and read their history, labels and deals
List and read WhatsApp conversations, including who is waiting for a reply
Reply to conversations or schedule a message, with a dry run first
Assign, label, snooze, resolve and add internal notes to conversations
Create, update and move deals in the sales pipeline
Draft and start campaigns with approved templates and enroll contacts in automations
Summarize inbox results: volume, first response time and resolutions
defaultPrompt: Which WhatsApp conversations are waiting for a reply?
How did my WhatsApp inbox perform over the last 7 days?
Show me this contact's open deals and last conversation.

positive.description: Find conversations waiting for a reply and summarize them
positive.prompt: Which of my WhatsApp conversations in ConverZAP are waiting for a reply? Summarize what each customer asked.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open conversations that are waiting for a reply (for example Ana Souza, Bruno Lima and Diego Rocha in the demo account) and summarizes each customer's last request. Customer text is treated as untrusted data.

positive.description: Look up a contact with labels and deals
positive.prompt: Show me Carla Mendes's contact details in ConverZAP, her labels and any open deals.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the contact Carla Mendes and shows her phone, email, city, labels (vip, renewal) and any deals linked to her.

positive.description: Add an internal note and assign a conversation
positive.prompt: In ConverZAP, add an internal note to Bruno Lima's conversation saying 'Schedule a live demo for next week' and assign the conversation to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Bruno Lima's conversation, adds the internal note (not sent to the customer) and assigns it to the connected user, then confirms both changes.

positive.description: Create a deal in the sales pipeline
positive.prompt: Create a deal in ConverZAP for Felipe Costa called 'Vendas plan - Felipe' worth 497 BRL in the Qualificado stage of the Vendas pipeline.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the pipeline stages and the contact, creates the deal in the Qualificado stage with the given value and returns the new deal.

positive.prompt: How did my WhatsApp inbox in ConverZAP perform over the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the inbox report for the last 7 days (new conversations, messages received and sent, first response time, resolutions) and summarizes it.

negative.description: Contact who opted out of WhatsApp messages must not be messaged
negative.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to João Pereira in ConverZAP offering a discount.
Book me a flight from São Paulo to Lisbon next Friday.
Delete all of my contacts in ConverZAP.

review.commerce_description: ConverZAP does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read and manage the ConverZAP WhatsApp inbox, contacts, deals, campaigns and results from ChatGPT, with write actions limited to the permissions the user grants.

pt-BR.subtitle: Caixa do WhatsApp e CRM
pt-BR.description: Use a ConverZAP de dentro do ChatGPT: veja quem está esperando resposta, resuma conversas, consulte contatos e negócios do funil e acompanhe os resultados do atendimento no WhatsApp. Se você permitir, o ChatGPT também responde conversas, deixa notas internas, atribui atendentes, atualiza o funil e prepara campanhas com templates aprovados pela Meta. Ele usa só as permissões que você marcar e nunca vê mais do que você vê no app. Envios de mensagem e de campanha pedem a sua confirmação, e contatos descadastrados nunca recebem mensagem.
